steps.description:
Coding is a vital tool in linguistics, powering everything from text analysis and speech processing to building intelligent systems that understand language. AI models are a great example of how coding has enabled programs to communicate with humans.

You can use Create-text-with block to join text as shown. Note that you must assign a text to the variable before adding another text behind it.


If you're building a game and designing characters, you'll probably want to name them. So why not write some code that surprises you with creative, unexpected names?


We can break a name into syllables, which are units of sound in speech. For example, Benjamin divides into Ben-ja-min (3 syllables). 

Write code so that each time Button D22 is pressed and released, it randomly selects three syllables from the table below to form a name and displays it on the LCD. The program runs continuously.


You can add more syllables if you feel like it!


Recall that you can assign a random number to a variable and check what the number is in order to perform different actions.
